rationale:
Second batch of handler-side commit_sha standardisation for bugs_open/334 (RFC_029 step 5's real gate), following migration 519 (page-rerender, submitted, awaiting verdict). Same mechanism, same council-approved shape: rerender-pages is a real, live bdl handler (confirmed against site_work_items.handler_agent, the top-level dispatch column, not a static list) with its own direct git_commit step. Single direct git_commit step (deploy_js_snippets), single path to complete with no branching that skips the commit and no second git-touching call — no ambiguity about which commit is canonical.

Same conversion as 519 and the same reason it is required, not merely convenient: rerender-pages's `complete` step currently uses `output_fields` (list mode), which uses each entry as both the extraction path and the response key — a dotted path added to the list would produce a response key that is that literal string, invisible to any dot-path reader. `result_mapping` is the only mode that builds an independently-named target<-source map, and it is mutually exclusive with `output_fields`. So this is a controlled conversion: every currently-exposed field re-declared as an identity mapping (byte-identical response for existing readers), plus one new `commit_sha` entry.
